reference_supplement: Russia proposed replacing the explicit humanitarian principles in paragraph 6 of S/2020/24 with a reference to General Assembly resolution 46/182. Belgium, speaking for both penholders, argued that this conflicted with the exceptional cross-border mechanism and urged adoption of their original text. Belgium said there was no viable alternative then to Al Yarubiyah and noted the draft's request for the Secretary-General to examine alternatives by the end of February. The oral amendment fell short with three votes in favour, seven against and five abstentions. The Council then adopted S/2020/24 unamended. After adoption, Russia withdrew its separate draft S/2020/25 in light of that result.
